posts.title: We Gave AI Agents the Keys Before Building the Locks
posts.description: AI infrastructure excels at optimizing inference, reusing context and executing actions. But as agents take on real enterprise access and money, one critical capability remains missing: delegated authority that holds from intent to commit.

posts.title: Your Personal and Edge AI Needs a Consistency Model
posts.description: Once your phone, laptop, car and the cloud each hold agent state, each one is a replica. Databases learned to name the consistency each operation needs. Agents have not.

posts.title: Your AI Agent Needs a Transaction Manager
posts.description: Agentic AI is beginning to rediscover the transaction manager, recovery system, security model and workload governor.
